protocol.target: Fixed128-row chunks, common seeded next-action noise; target cloned trainingBN on current+next mix; terminated masks bootstrap entirely, truncated does not; next_obs is saved pre-reset final observation.
protocol.gradients: Existing actor_gradient_metrics: cloned actor training=True on fixed obs+next_obs batch1024, critic training=False,3 shared RNG repetitions; raw unpreconditioned parameter gradients, not actual replay batch/Adam/AMP/post-step unit normalization.

entropy.conditional_policy: tanh(Normal(mean,std)), independent-noise one-step conditional density; cached collector temporal dependence not included.

protocol.counterfactual: Rescale alpha only inside target formula with existing learned target probabilities; not a newly fitted Q and not a training experiment.
protocol.next_entropy_contribution_field: Stored next_entropy_contribution is the unmasked -alpha*log_pi diagnostic. At terminated=True it has ZERO effect on target: target_metrics multiplies the entire next-value/entropy term by (1-terminated).

limits: Exact same expert states and random draws across four checkpoints; Q/normalizer/actor differ because training histories differ. Native rollout reports use other states and phase-balanced selectors; keep their numbers separate.
Successful terminal transitions cannot contain next-state entropy or bootstrap in target. Nonterminal lift-bonus transitions are separate.
Inference Q near support floor and clipped targets do not establish true finite/infinite return values, but do show the chosen categorical objective is heavily projected.
Freeze treatment protects policy while actor updates are disabled; this online experiment does not equal fixed-dataset critic calibration or isolate all reasons for post-unfreeze loss.
No new simulator/GPU run, live optimizer/core/queue change, or checkpoint mutation was made.

entropy_strength_followup.minimal_contrast: Same calibrated BC actor and fresh critic initialization, same2000-call warmup, alpha_init=.01 versus.0001, native adaptive-temperature updates otherwise unchanged; bounded2M transitions, same LR19532.
entropy_strength_followup.parent_planned_extension: Six arms alpha_init .01/.0001/.000001 × warmup0/2000, prepared by another agent; this analysis did not create/modify/launch that queue.
entropy_strength_followup.important_loading_rule: agent.load always replaces temperature from temperature.pt even when load_optimizer=false. Clone initial checkpoint with only log_temp changed; training temp_initial_value override alone is ineffective.
entropy_strength_followup.target_entropy_rule: Agent derives target entropy from temp_target_sigma=.15; direct temp_target_entropy config is overwritten in constructor.
entropy_strength_followup.causal_limit: Changing alpha affects actor loss AND soft critic target AND adaptive-temperature trajectory. This A/B does not isolate those paths.

numerical_check.dtype: float32 log_temp, native exp, Adam eps1e-8
numerical_check.limit: Finite and well above epsilon for this starting condition, not a promise that relative alpha adaptation stays identical for different histories or near zero entropy error.
